ui.tagline: A game about raising one tiny eraser crumb.
ui.parents: About / このゲームについて
ui.namingLead: A crumb fell on the desk.
ui.namingNote: The name is saved only on this device.
ui.tut1Body: Tap anywhere on the desk to rub the eraser and make "crumbs". You can also drag it back and forth. Save up crumbs to buy tools.
ui.tut2Body: Buy a "Finger" in the Shop. It rubs for you automatically.
ui.tut2BodyMobile: Open the Shop tab below and buy a "Finger". It rubs for you.
ui.tut3Body: Rubbing wears your eraser down. When it is used up, you get an Eraser Sleeve. Use sleeves on the Roll page to make a new crumb. Buy materials in the Shop to add more colors. Fill up the Crumbpedia!
ui.rollAllFound: All colors found for now! Buy materials or reach the next STAGE
ui.rollNoTicket: No sleeves left. Rub until your eraser is used up
ui.gColorsNote: Buy materials in the Shop for more
ui.praiseHelp: Praise makes the crumb happy for 30s: /s x1.5. Once every 60s
ui.blowHelp: Blow to gather the scattered crumbs (now +{v}). Your crumb flies away for 3s
ui.deskEmpty: Nothing here yet. Buy a tool in the Shop.
ui.rocketBig: The last piece was a jackpot!
ui.eraserLead: Visiting erasers get more ★ the more you use them, and each ★ makes them stronger. ★ are kept when you go back to the eraser.
ui.eraserLocked: Visits after you find a STAGE {n} crumb
ui.rolledShape: It rolled into a weird shape!
ui.achTap: Tap an award to see more.
ui.shardShopDesc: Things you buy here stay forever, even after going back to the eraser.
ui.shardOrder: In each path, buy from the top down.
ui.shardNext: {n} more crumbs to the next shard
ui.shardPending: Go back to the eraser now to get {n} shards.
ui.shardPendingNone: Going back to the eraser now gives no shards yet.
ui.rebirthLead:
The crumbs gather and become an eraser.
The eraser will erase something again.
ui.rebirthNone: You would get no shards now. You get 1 shard at 1T crumbs in total.
ui.rebirthNarration: The eraser will erase something again.
ui.welcomeLine: While you were gone, I thought about how to get rounder.
ui.restBody: You played for 30 minutes. The crumb looks a bit sleepy. Your tools keep working even when you close the game.
ui.restSleeping: The crumb is sleeping. Good night.
ui.resetConfirm1: Really delete? Your Crumbpedia and awards will be gone too.
ui.parentsTitle: About / このゲームについて
ui.parentsBody:
No ads, no purchases, no links to other sites.
Data is saved only on this device.
No personal information is sent.
A break reminder appears every 30 minutes.
ui.parentsBodyEn: 広告・課金・外部リンクはありません。データはこの端末の中だけに保存されます。
ui.parentsBodyAds:
There are optional ads: you choose whether to watch. You can play everything without them.
No purchases, no links to other sites.
Data is saved on this device.
This game sends no personal information.
A break reminder appears every 30 minutes.
ui.parentsBodyEnAds: 広告は見るかどうかを選べます。課金はありません。
ui.adBoostHelp: Watch an ad to double /s and rubbing for a while
ui.adBoostBody: Watch an ad to double /s and rubbing for {m} minutes.
ui.adNote: Ads are optional. You can play without them.
ui.adFail: The ad could not load. Maybe next time.
ui.saveExportLead: Copy this text and keep it. You can continue on another device.
ui.saveImportWarn: Importing will overwrite your current data.
ui.importBad: That text does not look right
ui.drawerLead: Put a material in the drawer and wait. After a while, it turns into something. It keeps growing while the game is closed.
ui.drawerLockHint: Opens at {n} kinds in the Crumbpedia
ui.drawerNeedMat: Buy {m} under Mix to use it
ui.drawerStep1: Press "Put in" on a material below (materials you bought under Mix)
ui.drawerStep2: Wait (it keeps growing while the game is closed)
ui.effNeri: For {dur}s, rubbed crumbs stick on: x{mult}
ui.effRocket: Every 10 rubs, a piece pops out ({pieces} left)
ui.effRocketBig: . The last one is a jackpot
ui.effDendo: For {dur}s, hold to keep rubbing. Rubbing x{mult}
ui.effJumbo: {rubs} rubs, each worth {mins} minutes of tool output
ui.star5_sand: Your eraser stops wearing down faster
ui.star5_rocket: The last piece becomes a jackpot
